_source.title: 清除扩展所有用户配置
_source.remarks.text.0: 此举会删除当前扩展的所有用户配置信息，请谨慎操作
_source.remarks.text.1: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`

title: Clear all user configurations of the extension
remarks.text.0: This will delete all user configuration information of the current extension. Please operate with caution
remarks.text.1: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
